name: Full Framework Bootstrap
intent: Initialize the entire Z0TH Framework: scan, assess, bootstrap contracts, and generate the first dashboard report.
scope: Does not modify any local_null_ai_* tool code.

steps.title: Full scan
steps.prompt: Run `python3 orchestrator.py scan` to re-index all local_null_ai tool folders.

steps.title: Assess all tools
steps.prompt: Run `python3 orchestrator.py assess` to score all tools and generate the enhancement plan.

steps.title: Bootstrap contracts
steps.prompt: Run `python3 orchestrator.py bootstrap-contracts` to create TOOL.md and manifest.json for every indexed tool.

steps.title: Generate dashboard
steps.prompt: Run `python3 orchestrator.py dashboard` to view the full Parrot OS + tool health report.
